scripts.build: npm i && cross-env NODE_ENV='production' NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=2048' tsc && tsc-alias && npm prune --omit=dev
scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV='production' node dist/server/src/index.js
scripts.dev: npm i && cross-env NODE_ENV='development' NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4048' concurrently --kill-others "tsc -w" "tsc-alias -w" "node --watch --trace-warnings --inspect dist/server/src/index.js"
scripts.dev:electron: npm i && cross-env NODE_ENV='development' NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4048' concurrently --kill-others "tsc -w" "tsc-alias -w" "node --watch --trace-warnings --inspect dist/server/src/testElectron.js"
